verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a remote-desktop product, so this axis applies. However, the evidence documents only a scriptable CLI and a REST API for automating installation, sessions and account data. Neither is an AI assistant that can take delegated tasks, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
